enable_language(C)
foreach(pair IN ITEMS
    "yyjson.c;98489c068ab65298320710e5be4c1090af1b5676e41301a3525b2e732641aace"
    "yyjson.h;adce02aef5dfd868f7c0b632bd23bc0e79fa710b70d93bfe334c2bd15b21a41d")
    list(GET pair 0 name)
    list(GET pair 1 expected)
    file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${name}" actual)
    if(NOT actual STREQUAL expected)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "yyjson 0.10.0 source hash mismatch: ${name}")
    endif()
endforeach()
add_library(ludus_yyjson STATIC yyjson.c)
set_target_properties(ludus_yyjson PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 EXPORT_NAME Yyjson)
target_include_directories(ludus_yyjson SYSTEM PUBLIC "$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}>")
install(TARGETS ludus_yyjson EXPORT LudusTargets ARCHIVE DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}")
install(FILES LICENSE DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/Ludus/licenses" RENAME yyjson-LICENSE.txt)

set(_audio_dependency_sanitizers "")
if(LUDUS_ENABLE_ASAN)
    list(APPEND _audio_dependency_sanitizers address)
endif()
if(LUDUS_ENABLE_UBSAN)
    list(APPEND _audio_dependency_sanitizers undefined)
endif()
if(LUDUS_ENABLE_TSAN)
    list(APPEND _audio_dependency_sanitizers thread)
endif()
if(_audio_dependency_sanitizers)
    list(JOIN _audio_dependency_sanitizers "," _audio_dependency_sanitizer_flags)
    target_compile_options(ludus_yyjson PRIVATE -fsanitize=${_audio_dependency_sanitizer_flags} -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
endif()
